title: x402-offer listing
description: What a buyer was told before the task: a paid skill's price, and the network, asset and pay-to of each way to pay it. `python x402_offer.py check --listing FILE` judges the agent's offer against this instead of the listing the agent publishes itself.

skill.description: The skill's id on the agent card.

price_usd.description: The listed price in dollars, rounded up to the asset's smallest unit.

price_atomic.description: The listed price in the asset's smallest units; wins over price_usd.

decimals.description: The asset's decimals; needed only when the asset isn't USDC.

options.description: Every way to pay that the listing names. An offer passes only if each of its options is one of these.

network.description: CAIP-2 (eip155:8453) or an x402 v1 name (base).

asset.description: "USDC" for Circle's USDC on that network, or the asset's address.

source.description: Where the listing came from, recorded in the bundle.
